title: Tilted UI plane feature tour
summary: A dark product interface travels past the camera in six capability stops, cuts to a resource grid, then resolves into a glowing mark, short promise, and typed URL.
use_when: A multi-screen product needs a compact capability tour
The interface can be rebuilt as one continuous spatial canvas
A silent launch cut needs readable UI and a clear closing URL

look.type_style: bold rounded grotesk for the opening at 8-10 % of frame height; compact sans UI at 2-4 %; medium grotesk close at 5 %

sfx.event: camera arrives at the next interface region
resource grid dissolves to the mark

structure.shot: dark landing UI with a two-clause hero promise, two actions, and a floating result card
structure.camera: tilt-plane; dolly right at about 94 px/s @1920 with push-in 1.00->1.10 over 128 fr
structure.motion: plane appears by easings.outExpo over about 8 fr (±0.25 s); camera uses easings.inOutSine for 128 fr

structure.shot: single-column sign-in panel with provider, credential, recovery, and primary-action controls
structure.camera: tilt-plane; vertical dolly about 39 px/s @1920, scale nearly constant over 82 fr
structure.motion: shared UI plane moves on easings.inOutSine for 82 fr; no separate element entrance is visible

structure.shot: upload workspace with a short status line, large drop zone, file formats, and one browse action
structure.camera: tilt-plane; lateral dolly about 118 px/s @1920 over 60 fr, scale nearly constant
structure.motion: shared UI plane moves on easings.inOutSine for 60 fr; focus stays on the drop zone

structure.shot: generated summary view with navigation tabs, one content panel, and a two-choice check below
structure.camera: tilt-plane; push-in accelerates to about 1.10 while the plane travels diagonally over 83 fr
structure.motion: camera uses easings.inOutSine for 83 fr; fast middle move carries visible motion-blur (shutter not measurable)

structure.shot: quiz state with a question panel, progress controls, and stacked answer choices
structure.camera: tilt-plane; diagonal dolly about 420 px/s @1920 with pull-out about 1.10->1.00 over 97 fr
structure.motion: camera uses easings.inOutSine for 97 fr; motion-blur carries the fastest part (shutter not measurable)

structure.shot: flashcard study state with numbered progress, mode controls, one large card, and a reveal action
structure.camera: tilt-plane; lateral dolly about 78 px/s @1920 with subtle push-in 1.00->1.02 over 114 fr
structure.motion: continuous camera travel on easings.linear for 114 fr; interface remains fully assembled

structure.shot: tilted grid of four external learning-resource cards with thumbnails and primary actions
structure.camera: tilt-plane; slow pull-out about 1.00->0.98 over 100 fr
structure.motion: grid holds while camera uses easings.inOutSine for 100 fr; no separate element entrance is visible

structure.shot: resource grid darkens and blurs into an empty black stage
structure.camera: tilt-plane; pull-out continues through the 9 fr overlap
structure.motion: 9 fr blur-dissolve on easings.inOutSine (exact blur radius not measurable)

structure.shot: small mark appears alone on black, brightens, grows, and travels toward the right side
structure.camera: subtle push-in about 1.00->1.02 over 85 fr while the mark crosses the frame
structure.motion: mark light-on about 14 fr (±0.25 s), halo lags about 5 fr (±0.25 s); easings.inOutSine travel 85 fr

structure.shot: four-word brand promise sits left of the dimmed mark on black
structure.motion: line completes left-to-right in about 8 fr with easings.outExpo (±0.25 s); mark dims over about 8 fr

structure.shot: centred URL types on black, then holds with a soft white halo
structure.motion: URL typewriter about 1 fr per character through 26.77 s (±0.25 s); easings.linear push and 43 fr final hold

params.brand: any brand.json; the recipe derives a dark stage from its tokens and uses its mark, type, radius, and accents
params.content.uiScreens: copy for six branded states: landing, sign-in, upload, summary, quiz, and flashcard
params.content.resourceCards: four learning-resource cards with title and metadata
params.content.closingLine: short promise shown beside the mark
params.content.url: short domain typed during the final row
params.cameraStops: six optional direction overrides for the UI plane camera stops; -1 travels left, 1 travels right

notes: Eleven contiguous rows from six visible UI state changes, the 18.80 s hard cut, and both bounds of the 22.13-22.43 s soft transition. Silent reference: cut_on_beat is false (0/2; no beats). Sub-0.25 s entrances, overshoot, blur shutter, and exact easing are not measurable. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured. Recipe-local UI and resource components implement the proposed continuous-plane-tour without shared-studio changes.
